summary: The three geodetic layers satisfy no exact algebraic identity, so the invariant convention behind geod_2ndinv is not recoverable.
evidence: Tested on 5,164,312 in-footprint pixels: sqrt(dil^2+shear^2) max |error| 33.8 on a field with median 19.9 (best r = 0.9934); sqrt((dil^2+shear^2)/2), sqrt(dil^2+2 shear^2), |dil|+|shear| all worse. geod_2ndinv >= |shear| holds everywhere but geod_2ndinv >= |dil| holds only 82% of the time.
status: OPEN - Stage 1 is stated in quantile space, which is invariant to the unknown convention.

summary: Any feature derived from the catalogue is a perfect training leak in a blocked holdout.
evidence: With d_cat and cat_dens in the feature matrix, in-block AUC was exactly 0.500 while the physical features alone reach 0.63; removing them recovered in-block AUC to 0.667. Cause: every training positive is itself a catalogue pixel, so d_cat == 0 for all positives and > 0 for all negatives.
status: CLOSED - catalogue-derived columns excluded from the model, used only at emission time.

summary: Auto-context stacking improves RANKING consistently but does not convert that into score: in-block AUC +0.0085 (0.6652 -> 0.6737) while paired DTI at the shipped mass moves only +0.0012, and the per-fold deltas alternate sign (+0.0102, -0.0092, +0.0012, -0.0117, +0.0012, +0.0157).
evidence: evidence/autocontext_holdout.json (6 folds x 2 levels x 4 mass ratios, 1658 s). Paired L2-L1 at r3.47: iso +0.0012 (4/6), ste +0.0006 (3/6).
status: CLOSED 2026-10-07 as a NEGATIVE RESULT. The preregistered promotion rule (paired mean >= +0.006 AND >= 4/6 folds positive) is not met: 4/6 folds but only +0.0012. Level 2 is NOT shipped. Diagnosis worth carrying forward: the AUC gain is real and consistent, but it is concentrated in re-ordering pixels that were already inside the emitted top 3.47x|G| mass, so it buys no new credit. The lesson is that global AUC is the wrong proxy for this metric - the right proxy is credit-per-dot at the shipped mass, which is what evidence/emission_geometry.json reports. Code retained at src/gems51/autocontext.py and reachable via scripts/build_submission_v2.py --level 2.

summary: The 3-fold pilot of strike-coherent trace emission overstated the effect by 65%: +0.0033 on folds 0,2,4 became +0.0020 on all six, and the best w_cont moved from 0.7 to 0.35.
evidence: evidence/emission_geometry.json. Per-fold paired delta for ste_L9_w0.35_s2.4_nothin vs iso_nms_r2.4: +0.0023, +0.0029, +0.0042, -0.0023, -0.0019, +0.0065; mean +0.0020, 4/6, sign-test p = 0.344. The w_cont=0 control reproduces the incumbent to within 2e-4 on every fold, which validates the implementation as a strict generalisation of isotropic NMS.
status: OPEN as a methodological warning, ACTED ON for this session's ship. Folds 0, 2 and 4 are not a random subset of the six - they are the three EASIEST folds (incumbent DTI 0.2752 / 0.2843 / 0.3070 against 0.2691 / 0.2485 / 0.3057 for the rest), so any pilot on them is biased optimistic. Rule adopted: no emission or detector change is promoted on fewer than all six folds. w_cont = 0.35 is shipped rather than the pilot's 0.7 because it has the same mean on six folds with a 5x smaller worst-fold loss (-0.0023 vs -0.0101).

summary: The blocked-holdout instrument is structurally blind to catalogue-suppressed positional refinement. The snap surface that H-51-L moves dots along MUST be suppressed around the mapped catalogue (mass within ~200 m of mapped faults is dead mass live - the mechanism behind the group's 0.2600 -> 0.2708 -> 0.2778 gains by B-pruning). But in the blocked holdout the pretend-hidden truth IS the block's catalogue pixels, so suppression zeroes the surface exactly where the instrument's truth sits. A refinement that works live can therefore never be rewarded by this holdout, and one that passes this holdout would be suspect live. H-51-L was falsified on the instrument anyway (window=2 -0.0033 DTI at conserved mass; window=1 neutral), but the instrument's verdict on suppressed-surface refinements is bounded by this argument.
evidence: scripts/run_refine_holdout.py + data/refine_holdout.json + evidence/refine_*.json (session 2026-10-07 sweep); the B-prune mechanism is documented in knowledge/02 section 1 from GEMSDOE32 Round 4.
severity: medium - limits what the local instrument can license; does not affect format/legal checks
status: open - a refinement experiment needs either a non-catalogue truth model or a live slot with a pre-registered safety factor
